name: yieldanchor-protocol
description: YieldAnchor Protocol — Stellar/Soroban RWA yield infrastructure monorepo

scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:indexer
scripts.//typecheck: Packages are compiled first so their declarations exist for apps/ and services/ to resolve. scripts/ is type-checked separately: it is run through tsx rather than compiled as a workspace.
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r run typecheck && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run test:packages && pnpm run test:workspaces && pnpm run contract:test
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules services/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist services/*/dist packages/*/dist
scripts.//contract:deploy: Shell path: requires the stellar CLI on PATH and builds the wasm itself.
scripts.//contract:deploy:ts: TypeScript path: deploys through @yieldanchor/contract-clients, so packages and the wasm must be built first.
scripts.contract:deploy:ts: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run contract:build && tsx scripts/deploy/deploy-yield-vault.ts
scripts.//testnet:round-trip: Live Testnet smoke test against the deployed vault. Spends Testnet fees.
